name: Zendesk Agent Workspace
verified_note: Template. Use role-based locators; Zendesk theming varies by plan and admin customisation.
quirks: Public reply vs internal note is a separate control — verify it before every submit.
'Submit as <status>' couples the reply with a status change.
Side conversations and CCs are separate panes; the main thread may not show everything.
SLA badges are computed; never restate a deadline the policy does not support.
auth: Browse MCP reuses the logged-in browser session.

verify: navigate to a test view; snapshot --interactive; fix selectors; set verified
read_thread: open the ticket; snapshot the conversation; separate public replies from internal notes
capture requester, org, priority, SLA badge, tags, and any linked side conversations
send_reply: set the reply type to Public reply (not Internal note)
type into the editor, click Submit as <status>, wait for the comment to render
update_status: change status to Pending only when the next move is the customer's

guardrails: Public reply vs internal note is the highest-risk control in Zendesk; verify the mode and read the text before submitting.
Do not solve tickets that are assigned to another agent without a handoff note.
SLA badges are read-only signal; never claim a deadline the policy does not support.
